facts.content: The Institute of Science, Mumbai is a constituent institute of Dr. Homi Bhabha State University. The Institute is located at 15, Madam Cama Road, Fort, Mumbai.

The Institute has a library with a reading hall and print and digital collections. The library supports teaching and research, and its facilities include computer systems, internet connectivity, cataloguing systems, and access to digital academic resources.
The Institute library provides INFLIBNET-backed access to e-books and online journals for students, faculty, and researchers.

The Institute library describes photocopying and printing services, departmental libraries, and book lending. Its published library information states a 15-day book lending period and a late fee of ₹1 per day per book. Students should confirm current rules with the library before relying on fees or borrowing conditions.
The Institute lists a Gymkhana with a gymnasium and indoor gaming facilities. The Institute also describes opportunities for intercollegiate participation.
The Institute has an on-campus botanical garden with uncommon plant collections. The Institute describes it as having educational and ecological value.

The Dr. Homi Bhabha State University Annual Report for 2023-24 describes counselling and mentorship programmes at the Institute of Science. Faculty members provide individual guidance intended to support students' personal, academic, and professional goals. Students should contact the Institute for current arrangements and availability.

The Dr. Homi Bhabha State University 2026-27 brochure states that hostel seats are reserved for eligible University students at the Government Hostel at Churchgate (C Road) and at Telang Memorial Girls' Hostel at Churchgate. The brochure says applications are made online to the Joint Director of Higher Education, Mumbai. Hostel admission is subject to eligibility, application, and seat availability; students should check the current University instructions before applying.

For general administrative enquiries, students can contact the Institute of Science, Mumbai through its board line at +91-22-2282-9293 or email enquiry@iscm.ac.in. The published office hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and Saturday, 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM. Sunday is closed. Students can explain their query and ask the office to direct them to the appropriate department. The website does not provide a complete department-wise administrative office directory.

For University-level administrative enquiries, students can contact Dr. Homi Bhabha State University at 022-35136751 or info@hbsu.ac.in. The published University working hours are 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Dr. Homi Bhabha State University provides an online grievance form for formal complaints involving a teacher, officer, staff member, section, or department. The form requests student and complaint details. This facility is intended for grievances, not necessarily routine administrative enquiries.

The official contact information reviewed lists the Institute's general board line and enquiry email but does not identify a separate IT helpdesk contact. Students with IT-related queries can contact the general Institute enquiry office and request the appropriate technical support contact.
